steps.intro: شرط در یک زمان، نتیجه در زمان دیگر. برخلاف type 2/3 که هر دو زمان یکی است.

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.fa: اگر پزشکی خوانده بودم الان دکتر بودم.

examples.en: If I were more organized, I wouldn't have missed the deadline.
examples.fa: اگر منظم‌تر بودم ددلاین را از دست نمی‌دادم.

examples.en: If she had left earlier, she would be here now.
examples.fa: اگر زودتر رفته بود الان اینجا بود.

examples.en: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have crashed.
examples.fa: اگر مراقب‌تر بود تصادف نمی‌کرد.

steps.note: شرط گذشته → نتیجهٔ حال · شرط حال → نتیجهٔ گذشته

mistake.wrong: If I studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
mistake.right: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
mistake.whyFa: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → had + pp + would + base.

items.prompt: If I had studied, I ___ a doctor now.
items.why: نتیجهٔ حال → would be.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (be) taller, I would have joined the team.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → were.

items.prompt: If she had left earlier, she ___ here now.
items.why: نتیجهٔ حال (now) → would be.

steps.intro: if + had + pp, would + base (+ now).

examples.en: If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't feel sick now.
examples.fa: اگر اینقدر غذا نمی‌خوردم الان حالم بد نبود.

examples.en: If I hadn't broken my leg, I would be playing football now.
examples.fa: اگر پام را نشکسته بودم الان فوتبال بازی می‌کردم.

examples.en: If he had taken the job, he would be living in London now.
examples.fa: اگر کار را گرفته بود الان در لندن زندگی می‌کرد.

examples.en: If she had studied harder, she would be at university now.
examples.fa: اگر سخت‌تر درس خوانده بود الان دانشگاه بود.

mistake.wrong: If I hadn't broken my leg, I would have been playing football now.
mistake.right: If I hadn't broken my leg, I would be playing football now.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (not / break) my leg, I would be playing football now.
items.why: شرط گذشته → hadn't broken.

items.prompt: If he had taken the job, he ___ in London now.
items.why: نتیجهٔ حال → would be living.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If she ___ (study) harder, she would be at university now.
items.why: شرط گذشته → had studied.

steps.intro: if + past simple, would have + pp (+ then).

examples.en: If I were more organized, I wouldn't have missed the deadline.
examples.fa: اگر منظم‌تر بودم ددلاین را از دست نمی‌دادم.

examples.en: If I were you, I would have said no.
examples.fa: اگر جای تو بودم نه می‌گفتم.

examples.en: If she weren't so shy, she would have made more friends.
examples.fa: اگر اینقدر خجالتی نبود دوستان بیشتری پیدا می‌کرد.

examples.en: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have crashed.
examples.fa: اگر مراقب‌تر بود تصادف نمی‌کرد.

mistake.wrong: If I had been you, I would have said no.
mistake.right: If I were you, I would have said no. (mixed)
mistake.whyFa: «were you» شرط حال، «would have said» نتیجهٔ گذشته.

items.prompt: If I ___ you, I would have said no.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → were.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If she ___ (not / be) so shy, she would have made more friends.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → weren't.

items.prompt: If he ___ more careful, he wouldn't have crashed. (but he's careless)
items.why: شرط حال (careless است) → were.

steps.intro: now = نتیجهٔ حال · then = نتیجهٔ گذشته.

examples.en: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
examples.fa: اگر درس خوانده بودم الان دکتر بودم.

examples.en: If I were taller, I would have joined the team then.
examples.fa: اگر قدبلندتر بودم آن موقع عضو تیم می‌شدم.

examples.en: If I had money, I would have bought that house last year.
examples.fa: اگر پول داشتم سال گذشته آن خانه را می‌خریدم.

examples.en: If she were here, she would have helped us yesterday.
examples.fa: اگر دیروز اینجا بود کمکمان می‌کرد.

mistake.wrong: If I had studied, I would be a doctor then.
mistake.right: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.

items.prompt: کدام جمله mixed است؟
options: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
If I studied, I would be a doctor now.
If I had studied, I would have been a doctor then.
items.why: had studied + would be + now = mixed.

items.prompt: If I had money, I ___ that house last year.
items.why: نتیجهٔ گذشته (last year) → would have bought.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (know) you were coming, I would be at the airport now.
items.why: نتیجهٔ حال (now) + شرط گذشته → had known.

examples.en: ❌ If I studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
examples.fa: این اشتباه است — شرط و نتیجه ناهماهنگ‌اند.

examples.en: ✅ If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.fa: درست.

examples.en: ❌ If I had studied, I would be a doctor then.
examples.fa: then با نتیجهٔ گذشته جور است، نه حال.

examples.en: ✅ If I had studied, I would have been a doctor then.
examples.fa: درست.

steps.note: نشانهٔ now → would + base · نشانهٔ then → would have + pp.

mistake.wrong: If I studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
mistake.right: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
mistake.whyFa: شرط گذشته (had studied) + نتیجهٔ حال (would be).

items.prompt: کدام جمله غلط است؟
options: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
If I studied, I would have been a doctor now.
If I were taller, I would have joined.
items.why: «studied» (حال) + «would have been» (گذشته) ناهماهنگ است.
items.hint: زمان شرط و نتیجه یکی نیست.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (not / be) sick, I would be at work today.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → hadn't been.

items.prompt: If she ___ more patient, she wouldn't have shouted.
items.why: شرط حال (patient نیست) + نتیجهٔ گذشته → were.

steps.intro: mixed = شرط و نتیجه دو زمان. pure = یک زمان.

examples.en: Pure type 2: If I were rich, I would travel.
examples.fa: حال + حال.

examples.en: Pure type 3: If I had been rich, I would have traveled.
examples.fa: گذشته + گذشته.

examples.en: Mixed: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
examples.fa: گذشته + حال.

examples.en: Mixed: If I were more organized, I wouldn't have missed the deadline.
examples.fa: حال + گذشته.

steps.note: pure = یک زمان در هر دو clause.

mistake.wrong: If I had studied, I would be a doctor then.
mistake.right: If I had studied, I would have been a doctor then. (یا: would be a doctor now)
mistake.whyFa: then با نتیجهٔ گذشته جور است.

items.prompt: If I had left earlier, I ___ home now.
items.why: mixed: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال (now).

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (be) you, I would have apologized.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → were.

items.prompt: If I ___ harder at school, I would have a better job now.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → had worked.

steps.intro: ۱۲ تمرین متنوع. بعضی جمله‌ها درست هستند و نباید اصلاح شوند.
steps.note: هر سؤال را می‌توانی رد کنی.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (study) medicine, I would be a doctor now.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → had studied.

items.prompt: If I were you, I ___ that offer last week.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → would have accepted.

items.prompt: کدام mixed است؟
options: If I had left earlier, I would be home now.
If I left earlier, I would be home now.
If I had left earlier, I would have been home then.
items.why: had left + would be + now = mixed.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If she ___ (not / be) so shy, she would have made friends.
items.why: شرط حال + نتیجهٔ گذشته → weren't.

items.prompt: هر دو جای خالی را پر کن:
items.template: If I {0} studied, I {1} a doctor now.
items.why: had studied + would be.

items.prompt: کلمهٔ غلط را پیدا کن و شکل درستش را بنویس.
items.sentence: If I studied, I would have passed the exam last year.
items.why: نتیجهٔ گذشته (last year) → شرط گذشته: had studied.

items.prompt: If I ___ more careful, I wouldn't have lost my keys.
items.why: شرط حال (careful نیست) + نتیجهٔ گذشته → were.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (know) you were sick, I would be with you now.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → had known.

items.prompt: جمله را بساز:
items.answer: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
items.why: had studied + would be + now.

items.prompt: If she ___ the job, she would be in London now.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → had taken.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (not / eat) so much, I wouldn't feel sick now.
items.why: شرط گذشته + نتیجهٔ حال → hadn't eaten.

items.prompt: If I had seen the sign, I ___ that road last week.
items.why: نتیجهٔ گذشته (last week) → wouldn't have taken.
